title: Upcycle to recycle: triglyceride-derived magnesium soaps as stable, sustainable and efficient catalysts for poly(ethylene terephthalate) glycolysis
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,770-778
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00862J, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lorenzo Pedrini, Anshul Jain, Lauren Kenny, David T. Mannion, Kieran N. Kilcawley, Stephen J. Connon
Magnesium soaps are capable of promoting PET glycolysis with performance comparable to the most active literature systems. Optimal fatty acid-derived ligand chain lengths are identified and catalysts from (waste) cooking oil are highly active.
